posts.author: utunnels
posts.body:
I don't see in your pictures a plugin command, your last 2 pictures show and move picture command and the plugin parameters...
By the way, if you want the picture to stay in place without using plugin, here's a solution:
Explain:
The trick is to use two variables, which you set to map's scroll position using script.
x = -$gameMap.scrollX()*48 + XPositionYouWant;
y = -$gameMap.scrollY()*48 + YPositionYouWant;
Edit*
You can remove the Move Picture line.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Theponidraws said:
I used the “Move Picture” command
Click to expand...
the move picture command will never work, because you can't fine-tune it to the player movement. The move would have to change based on direction and speed and player input, and that is too much to handle with event commands (it would be a very complex event with more than a dozen conditional branches and risk of lag and more.
Theponidraws said:
Then, we tried by using a plug in (Galv's Layer Graphics Plugin) but it didn't work out,

but you never said what commands of the plugin you used or where you did not understand the instructions in the help section.

im still not entirely sure why you need the overlay. if all you wanted was for characters to appear behind a locker when they move onto a tile above its base, its been mentioned before how to do that

if the lockers arent already tiles, you can take the lockers and make a quick tilesheet using them, give the upper portions the star passability rule, and then place the lockers as tiles. you could also take the entire lockers, make them a single 3 tile high event, and characters will appear to walk behind them. neither requires a plugin
